scene: The drone projects three glowing transit routes across the bustling plaza.
picture: A wide flat side-scrolling view along the paved street. The Pacific Islander girl stands left of centre holding the humming drone, with her sketchbook tucked underarm. On the far left, a spherical iridescent bubble lift waits open. Centre, a mirrored revolving door sits in a wall. Far right, a yellow gondola cabin rests at a loading platform.
shown: an iridescent glass bubble lift hovering near the ground on the far left
a mirrored revolving door entrance glowing warmly in the centre wall
a yellow gondola car dangling from an overhead cable on the right
